name: Blurring the Walls
source:
Welcome to "Blurring the Walls", a NTS/NTR visual novel following an inexperienced yet curious protagonist as he navigates risqué dynamics and indulges in temptation through playful exchanges with his girlfriend and their friends.

A summer vacation in Reivak with your girlfriend Ayumi. Simple enough, right?

Except nothing's ever simple when you mix beach vibes, lowered inhibitions, and a girlfriend who's way too good at pushing your buttons. What begins as playful teasing slowly evolves into something neither of you expected.

[I]Once the walls of your inhibitions start to blur, there's no turning back.[/i]

[From [url=https://torimiata.itch.io/blurring-the-walls]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到《Blurring the Walls》，这是一部NTS/NTR视觉小说，讲述了一个缺乏经验但充满好奇的主人公在与女友及其朋友的有趣交流中驾驭不雅动态并沉迷于诱惑的故事。

与女友Ayumi一起在雷瓦克度过暑假。很简单，对吧？

但当你将海滩氛围、低沉的压抑感和一个太会刺激你的女朋友混合在一起时，一切都变得不那么简单了。一开始只是开玩笑，慢慢地演变成你们都没有预料到的事情。

[I]一旦你的抑制之墙开始模糊，就没有回头路了。[/i]

[来自[url=https://torimiata.itch.io/blurring-the-walls]Itch.io[/url]]
